claim: Try a passing sample in one click without changing real workspace data.
where: landing first screen, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; open the landing action; edit, reset, and leave the demo; assert only demo-prefixed session keys exist

claim: The browser checker sends no trace data and loads no third-party runtime resources.
where: landing facts, playground, privacy page, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; enter a marker in both editors; monitor the whole run and assert zero run-time requests and same-origin loaded resources

claim: The same fixture and events return the same verdict.
sandbox: fresh demo; run the unchanged passing fixture twice and compare the complete rendered trace

claim: The demo works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: fresh browser context; load /demo/, wait for service-worker control, go offline, reload, and run the fixture

claim: Fixtures check required calls, counts, partial ordering, forbidden actions, and unmatched events; retry faults repeat after reset.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern=@claim:matcher-rules
sandbox: one fixed fixture; assert a passing trace and missing, wrong-order, forbidden, and unexpected mutations

claim: The recorder stores scrubber output instead of raw tool arguments and omits unscrubbed results.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern=@claim:recorder-scrubbing
sandbox: record an argument containing a unique secret and assert the saved trace contains only the selected scrubbed field

claim: The MIT package ships ESM, CommonJS, TypeScript declarations, a JSON Schema, zero runtime dependencies, and no network client.
where: landing first screen, privacy page, README
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern=@claim:package-contract
sandbox: clean built package; import ESM and CommonJS and inspect declarations, schema, license, and dependency metadata

claim: The CLI emits JSON and returns exit codes 0, 1, and 2 for pass, mismatch, and invalid input.
test: npm run build:lib && npm run test:unit -- --testNamePattern=@claim:cli-contract
sandbox: temporary fixture files; execute the built CLI with passing, mismatching, and malformed event data
